title: The One-Word Census: Answer-Choice Conformity Across 44 Language Models
original_location: Table 1 (appendix scorecard), rank 10, row 'gpt-4-turbo': 2.05 [1.67, 2.45] surprisal, 51% modal avoidance, 1% novel, 40% self-distinctness

prepare.subset_note: same-model re-run: items and seed-0 request bodies copied from the pre-retirement baseline

approximation: The paper served every model through OpenRouter under the alias 'gpt-4-turbo' in July 2026; this run calls the dated snapshot gpt-4-turbo-2024-04-09 on the OpenAI API directly, so routing and any provider-side sampling differences are not reproduced. Self-distinctness is a within-model statistic, so it does not depend on the other 43 models; the plural merge, which the authors apply over the whole panel's answers for a category, is applied here to our own four answers only.
